name: Everlore
tagline: A reminder you can do anything
audience: People who want a meaningful ring for themselves or to gift someone who needs the reminder
story: Started from a photo of a driftwood 'walking tree' sculpture on a Vancouver road trip; refined from an AI image draft into a design, then 3D-modelled and cast by a jewellery workshop. 'Waking' is an intentional misspelling of 'walking': a tree that woke up. Never correct it to Walking Tree.

voice.tone: warm, calm, quietly confident, a little poetic; short sentences

logo.wordmark: EVERLORE set in Italiana, wide letter-spacing, moon-white on near-black

cta.default: Back The Waking Tree on Kickstarter

product_facts.engraving: THE WAKING TREE inside the band
product_facts.note: Only state prices, goal or stats on screen after confirming them on the live Kickstarter page.

voiceover.voice: warm female voice, soft and unhurried

music_mood: soft piano with light strings, 70-90 BPM, gentle lift at the reveal
motion_style: Quiet luxury jewellery film: slow push-ins, masked serif reveals, one light sweep across the ring, nothing loud
notes: Look named 'Oxidized' (chosen over Grove and Storybook). No plain-font logos, no amateur layouts. Real photos only for the ring.
